rule: Errors crossing a module boundary must be wrapped with the operation that failed; never rethrow a bare cause.
Modules must use named exports; a default export hides the symbol from search and rename.
A function declaration that returns a promise must be marked async, even when its body only forwards another promise. This is about how the function is declared, not about call sites that await one.
Do not add barrel files that re-export a whole directory; import the module that owns the symbol.
Array and object parameters must be declared readonly unless the function is documented to mutate them.
Prefer a union of string literals over a TypeScript enum; enums emit runtime code and do not narrow well.
Exported functions must declare an explicit return type; inference at the module boundary makes breaking changes invisible.
Do not nest ternaries; use an early return or a lookup table when there are more than two branches.
Every container must declare a memory limit and a cpu request; an unbounded container can evict its neighbours.
Images must be pinned to an explicit version tag; latest and floating tags are not reproducible.
Long-starting workloads must declare a startupProbe so the liveness probe does not kill them during boot.
Every workload must carry app.kubernetes.io/name and app.kubernetes.io/part-of labels for selection and ownership.

rule: Do not log with console; use the structured logger so records carry the request id.
Do not type a lookup as an index signature; use Record with a named key union so a typo fails the build.
Imports must be grouped node builtins, then dependencies, then local modules, separated by a blank line.
Do not use the non-null assertion operator; narrow the value or fail loudly with a thrown error.
A leaf manifest must not set metadata.namespace; the kustomization group that includes it owns placement.
Stateful workloads must declare strategy type Recreate; a rolling update on a single volume deadlocks.
Thresholds, retry counts and delays must be named constants; never inline the number at the call site.

rule: Do not build log messages with f-strings; pass the values as arguments so the record keeps its fields.
Public functions must carry type hints on every parameter and on the return value.
Use pathlib for filesystem paths; os.path string joining hides platform bugs.
Never use a star import; name what you bring into the namespace so a reader can find it.

Do not use assert for runtime validation in library code; it disappears under python -O, so raise instead. Test files are exempt.
